explication: Mindwtr is an offline-first GTD task manager for desktop and mobile. The principal workflow is capture an idea, process it into actionable or deferred work, choose tasks through focus and calendar views, then review projects and loose ends. Local state is persisted on-device, with optional synchronization, attachments, imports, AI assistance, and external calendars. The graph reflects documented capabilities and sampled controllers/storage code; several integrations are represented at their exact enclosing paths where implementation details were not sampled.
